messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images, using the front view for the front styling and the back view for the back styling. Transfer only the hairstyle shape and structure from the references; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's original hair color, identity, and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands on a rooftop, initially facing forward, then turns to her left, raises her right hand to touch her hair, and finally returns to a forward-facing stance with her hands on her hips.","camera":"The camera maintains a static, medium-full shot from a slightly low angle, keeping the subject centered in the frame.","clothing":"She wears a long-sleeved pink sweater, a light pink pleated mini skirt, and black lace-up boots.","hair_color":"Dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"Her hair is styled in two high buns on top of her head.","identity":"A young woman with a slim build and light skin, shown in a 3D animated style.","scene":"The setting is an urban rooftop at dusk, featuring a tiled floor, a large grey ventilation unit, and a cityscape with buildings and construction cranes in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman's hair was restyled from a single high ponytail/bun into two high buns on top of her head, matching the reference hairstyle. Her dark hair color, face, pink outfit, boots, rooftop scene, camera, and motion remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to the reference style, transferring only shape/structure while preserving original hair color, identity, clothing, and all other video elements.
uncertain: Exact back-of-head styling could not be fully verified from the available frames, though the visible buns match the reference structure.
